description: 2 tactical challenges for Black in the Bellon Gambit. Play 3...e4! and clamp with 4...c6!.

drills.briefExplanation: 3...e4! 4.Ng5 c6! 5.d3 d5! — wedge, support, then the central break.
drills.description: Black to play. White develops 3.Nf3 — strike with the Bellon 3...e4!.
drills.explanation: The Bellon Gambit: Black plays 3...e4!, and after 4.Ng5 c6! the pawn is solid. When White tries 5.d3, Black breaks with 5...d5! — opening the center while the e4 wedge cramps White. The knight on g5 will retreat with loss of time; Black's space advantage is lasting.
drills.name: The e4 Wedge

drills.briefExplanation: 4...c6 5.d4 d5! 6.e3 dxc4 — support, break, and win the c-pawn.
drills.description: Black to play. White lunged 4.Ng5 — support with 4...c6! and meet 5.d4 with the 5...d5! break.
drills.explanation: The follow-through: after 3...e4 4.Ng5 c6!, White's 5.d4 is met by the central break 5...d5!. After 6.e3 Black plays 6...dxc4!, winning the c4 pawn — White's queenside is loosened, the e4 wedge cramps everything, and the g5 knight must retreat with loss of time. Black's space has become material.
drills.name: Supporting and Trading

name: Bellon Gambit — Black Tactics
